s286: When you send an enquiry through our contact or program forms, we collect the details you choose to provide, such as your name, email address, organization, location, the service you are interested in, timing, budget range and your message. s287: We do not ask for passport, ID or payment card numbers through the website. Please do not include them, or other sensitive or confidential information, in a form. This site is hosted on GitHub Pages, and like most web hosts, GitHub may process technical information such as IP addresses to deliver pages. We do not currently use analytics or advertising trackers on this site.
s289: We use your information to respond to your enquiry, prepare quotes, plan and deliver services, and keep a record of our communications. We do not sell personal information.

s293: We keep enquiry information only as long as needed to respond, deliver services and meet legal or accounting requirements, then delete or anonymize it.
